szn.review: Faltu ekta Faculty SZN... waste of money.
SZN ma'am gives you a motherly vibe. Very caring and cheerful. She is generous with marks in presentations, and exams are easy if you study. It was one of the courses I still miss doing.
SZN (though it's true that she's biased but amake bhalo grade dise easily).

taa.review: Drop TAA. He's biased when it comes to grading. If you continue, try to be interactive and participate in class discussions.
Easy pass but A is very hard.
I did ENG102/103 under him. He is really easygoing; follow his instructions and participate in class.
TAA best. Attend regularly and visit his office briefly before speeches. He is easygoing, and with a little effort you can get a good grade.

TAA is moderately good for learning. You have to put in a lot of effort. He gets agitated if you make grammatical mistakes and might be rude sometimes. He does not curve. I got an A- under him despite doing well on exams.
He was good; I enjoyed the course so much.

faa.review: Undoubtedly, FAA! You won't regret it.

FAA ma'am is a sweetheart and easygoing. She is generous to freshers and curves a lot. She is strict about attendance and appreciates class participation. Note her suggestions and examples because exam questions are often common from them. She is non-biased and rewards hardworking, attentive students.
She takes four presentations, two individual and two group. Her marking is very good; there is no drama or video presentation.

FAA ma'am is one of the sweetest people I've ever seen. She wants to help every student, is student-friendly and welcoming, and is easy to ask questions. I wasn't confident speaking, but I did well throughout the course with her.
Ma'am is so sweet and helpful. She takes one quiz, no midterm in my section, a final, and four presentations. Just follow her rules and be attentive in class.

nsj.review: NSJ is very strict about rules and everything else.
She is strict about attendance and being on time. Follow her rules thoroughly. She gives raw marks without a curve, but you can learn a lot from her.

I did ENG111 with NSJ ma'am. It was one of the most interactive and fun courses I've taken. I got an A, but it wasn't necessarily easy. Follow the rules, be creative in speech writing and presentation, and prepare from her exam suggestions.
NSJ miss is great for both learning and grading. Follow her instructions for speech writing and drama-related tasks. She is helpful and you can reach her with questions; A/A- is achievable.
NSJ miss is very supportive but strict about her rules. I missed one class and got a 25% deduction on impromptu speaking, but still ended up with A-. Follow her lectures and respond in class.
NSJ ki khub kharap? Etotau na, but if you take her you should give up hope for an A and study a lot.

sdma.review: SDMA ma'am is very easygoing and a lovely faculty.

kss.review: KSS is a biased faculty with average B/B+ grading.
Effort dile B/B+ paile to kharap bolbei jara korse. Oil dewa lagbe onek.

KSS ma'am is very friendly, but you have to make a good impression. She takes two or three quizzes; you don't need to study from the book. Quizzes, midterm, and final use a paragraph, and presentations and speeches are frequent. Confidence on stage matters most; she isn't focused on grammar or language mistakes.
KSS easy A paba if you can speak well and are confident enough. Ma'am is very friendly and the course has little pressure.
KSS ma'am is friendly. She gives good grades, but mixed reviews may be because students expect a high grade without effort.
For learning, KSS is poor; she is easygoing and grading is good. I dropped after the mid because I got very poor marks and felt she did not teach much in class.
KSS ma'am is biased and good for grading, not for learning.

lmh.review: LMH sir is easygoing; extra effort isn't needed, just follow his lecture. He teaches and explains very well, gives good marks, and grades according to the marks.

mnk.review: MNK is a little strict, but if you follow her rules, she is easygoing.
She curves one grade if she sees good class performance. She is pretty easygoing; pay attention and follow her instructions.
Average-level questions, but she gives good marks.
If you follow MNK's rules, she is a sweetheart and gives deserving grades.

I have done ENG102 and ENG103 under MNK. If your English is good, you follow her instructions and write without grammatical errors, it is easy to get an A. She welcomes questions and is never annoyed when you ask for help.

khu.review: She is an absolute gem. If you give speeches on topics you love, it is easy to get full marks.

I underperformed in my midterm due to a personal tragedy and got a B, but there is no faculty as sweet and kind as ma'am. She also helps with speeches. Getting good lessons and a good grade is easy under her.
The marking is such that a curve isn't needed.
She is an absolute gem. Nsu needs a lot more faculties like her.

szo.review: SZO is easygoing and grades fairly. You have to give three presentations. He doesn't curve; you'll get what you deserve.
Overall, the faculty was very good. I wasn't good at English, so I got a C, but the faculty was very good.
If you're doing it online and expect a good grade, I'd suggest SZO. I got A easily; he was chilled and accepted requests and excuses.

sts1.review: Just follow the speech rules and structure; she gives full marks. She doesn't deduct marks if you aren't fluent or get stuck, and she helps if you struggle with speeches.
STS1 is the best faculty for this course. Highly recommended.

mcd.review: MCD is a bit strict, but you can learn a lot and her grading is very good and fair.

lmd.review: LMD sir is the best for both learning and grading. He's very easygoing and friendly. If you concentrate in class and listen carefully, quizzes, midterms, and finals are easy and speech-writing topics are manageable.
Very easygoing. You will learn a lot from his course. He cooperates with his students.

hme.review: HME is also good. He gives deserving marks based on performance.
HME sir is great, but I've heard he grades strictly.

asw.review: Sir is very good. I respect him so much.

slq.review: SLQ ma'am is good, very friendly, and asks easy exam questions. She appreciates attentive students.
